item.title: KC's iconic Western Auto sign at risk of staying dark as World Cup deadline slips away
item.description: The towering landmark, perched atop the Western Auto Lofts, has been unlit for more than eight months.

item.title: Wendy's manager accused of shooting customer in the Northland
item.description: A manager at a Wendy's in Kansas City is facing charges after he's accused of shooting a customer.

item.title: Man charged in connection to sideshow that damaged Waldo street art
item.description: A man faces property damage and stunt-driving charges in connection with a sideshow last fall that damaged street art in the Waldo neighborhood.

item.title: New results: Barbies sold at Cargo Largo test positive for cocaine and fentanyl
item.description: Shipment of Barbie dolls at Cargo Largo in Independence, Missouri, found to contain cocaine with trace amounts of fentanyl.

item.title: New $1.4 billion AI data center heading to Liberty, Missouri
item.description: A new, $1.4 billion AI data center is heading to Liberty, Missouri, bringing one of the largest capital investments ever made in the state to the Kansas City metro.

item.title: Rare third eaglet hatches in Blue Springs as city confirms one sibling has died
item.description: The city of Blue Springs welcomed its third eaglet on Tuesday morning -- a rare phenomenon in which three bald eagle babies hatched from the same clutch. However, the moment quickly turned somber after the city announced one of the eaglets had died.

item.title: Kansas City man convicted of manslaughter sentenced to 8 years in prison
item.description: Gabriel Eredia was sentenced to 8 years in prison after pleading guilty in connection with a Kansas City deadly shooting on Nov. 18, 2023.

item.title: Vandalism, illegal dumping at Wyandotte County parks spark safety concerns
item.description: Wyandotte County Parks and Recreation said it has seen an increase recently in vandalism, theft and illegal dumping across its parks.

item.title: Man sentenced to federal prison for stealing 41 guns from Raytown store
item.description: A man was sentenced to prison for stealing firearms from a Raytown gun store in 2023, the U.S. Attorney's Office in Kansas City said.

item.title: NFL investigation into Rashee Rice abuse allegations ends with no discipline
item.description: The NFL has completed its investigation into accusations of abuse against Kansas City Chiefs wide receiver Rashee Rice, and it looks like Rice will avoid punishment from the league.

item.title: KU Hospital to close PICU, impacting critically ill children and families
item.description: The Pediatric Intensive Care Unit (PICU) at KU Hospital, a unit that has long served the most critically ill children in the region, is set to shut down in the coming months.

item.title: Metro ammunitions manufacturor's union to strike at midnight, union says
item.description: A local union is set to go on strike at midnight on Saturday after a vote rejecting a company management standard.

item.description: A cold front is expected to bring storms with damaging winds, hail, and possibly a tornado on Friday afternoon
